## 📊 What Gets Built

By following all 7 stages:

```
✅ 4 new projects (Application, Domain, Infrastructure, Tests)
✅ 5 service interfaces with proper contracts
✅ 3 infrastructure wrappers (adapter pattern)
✅ 5 commands + handlers (Play, Pause, Stop, Delete, Import)
✅ 3 queries + handlers (PlaybackState, CurrentChord, FilterProjects)
✅ CQRS buses (CommandBus, QueryBus)
✅ 2 ViewModels (PlaybackViewModel, LibraryViewModel)
✅ Complete DI container setup
✅ XAML bindings for commands

RESULT: Working CQRS architecture!
- App boots successfully
- Play/Pause/Stop buttons work
- Library operations work
- Search filtering works
```
